method: Native headless Edge, six deterministic 800x600 synthetic ImageBitmap fixtures, faithful game mock with unchanged 90 Hz pointermove gate and 8 commands per 50 ms queue.
timing: Measured decoding plus full preprocessing plus drawing and actual mock queue drain. Fixture construction and PNG generation are excluded. No remote-player acknowledgement is measured. Single runs vary with hardware and browser scheduling.
reference: Completed full-quality Ultra Fast raster from the previous exact-encoding revision; all 480000 RGBA pixels are compared, with no resampling, color or detail changes.
changes: Ultra Fast verifies all nineteen native even brush diameters 4..40, plus the existing 5 px brush, using public presets and wheel increments.
Complete mixed-color grid cells use main-color stamps, exact facets, shared corridor restoration and spatially grouped background repairs.
The shared axial interval helper supports bounded prefix-mask safety queries without changing brush geometry.
Dense small details can use an inverse mask, with original boundary marks retained/restored, exact bucket metadata rebuilt after pruning, and full raster verification.
Short axial strokes can use exactly equivalent endpoint stamps when the complete timeline is faster.
Deterministic work and memory budgets reject the complete candidate; simpler or unsuitable images decline additional searches early. Slow/Normal/Fastest remain unchanged.
verification: test-ultra-adjustments.cjs --baseline <previous revision>: legacy plans, deterministic complete raster equality, independent hard-brush replay, adjustment transforms, mixed grids, inverse masks and transactional budget fallback.

test-ultra-adjustments.cjs --baseline <previous revision> --browser --controls-only: legacy command sequences, four speed choices and Max migration, editor flow and actual grayscale drawing, strict-fill metadata, malformed/unsafe data, recent manual moves and cancellation.
test-ultra-brushes.cjs: 20 sizes, native transitions and corner clipping at two CSS scales; missing controls or ignored wheel events rejected before Clear.

benchmark-ultra.cjs --fixtures simple,portrait,multicolor,fractured,detail,windows --reference <previous completed native rasters> --reference-speed instant --assert-equal: all six RGBA rasters match, zero dropped moves and all commands delivered.
